messages:
maria-sales: FYI customer (Harry/Acme) just sent back the PSQ. Big blockers: they require HSM-signed bundles (FIPS 140-2), no egress telemetry, and a strict weekly minibundle cadence via USB only. also asking for a POC price for 2-week dedicated onprem capacity.
jon-sol-eng: Ok. Quick Qs: do they want bundle signing performed by their HSM (bring-your-own-key) or by our signing pipeline with attestations?
dina-sec: If they insist on BYOK HSM, we'll need a documented key exchange and signing protocol. We'll also need to confirm HSM type (PKCS#11?) and whether remote signing is allowed. :thinking_face:
harry-customer: They prefer BYOK. Their infra team uses Thales Luna and requires PKCS#11 interactions. No network egress for signing — can be physical token or an on-site signing appliance.
alex-ops: That fits our detached-signing flow but will need an ops-runbook update. We currently support two patterns: 1) customer-hosted signing appliance that we drive through an offline signing step, 2) pre-signed minibundles we ship. For #1 we'll need a signed manifest from them.
jon-sol-eng: Example manifest we discussed earlier (just a stub):
```
{
  "bundle_id": "acme-poc-2026-03",
  "components": ["runtime.tar.gz", "models.q8", "k8s-operator.tar"],
  "allowed_install_checksums": ["sha256:..."],
  "signer": "acme-luna-01",
  "sign_date": "2026-03-15T12:00:00Z"
}
```
This manifest is what our installer verifies before accepting a minibundle.
maria-sales: Procurement also wants an SOW that lists patch cadence and an SLA for hotfixes. They asked: can we commit to weekly minibundles for the POC, and what's the change-window?
tara-legal: We can draft SOW language for weekly minibundles during the 2-week POC, but production recurring weekly cadence needs a separate contract. Also note we may need language around liability for airgapped installs if customer signs the bundles locally.
dina-sec: About telemetry: we can offer a telemetry-opt-out build (no outbound telemetry and local-only logs). That will add ~2 business days to the build/test cycle for the POC. Also require explicit acceptance criteria in PSQ (no hidden pings).
harry-customer: Acceptance criteria: 1) Installer runs offline and validates signed manifest; 2) model weights load and inference < 300ms p50 on their GPU; 3) no outbound connections during install and runtime by default.
alex-ops: For packaging: we'll produce a zipped minibundle (USB-friendly) containing the runtime, model artifacts, and manifest + signature. We need an MD5/SHA checksum file and an instructions README for on-site operator. Shipping logistics: allow 48h for build + 24h for QA + 24h for signing by customer appliance. So 5 business days to first minibundle if BYOK signing is on their side.
jon-sol-eng: Pricing note: dedicated 2-week onprem POC with reserved capacity + ops support = estimate: $15k for infra + $6k for engineering support (build/sign/runbook) + travel if on-site support required. If we do remote-only guidance and they handle signing, drop travel.
maria-sales: I'll send a formal quote. Can someone confirm the deploy timeline so I can sync with procurement?
dina-sec: Confirmed: telemetry-opt-out build = +2 days. BYOK signing path = add 1 day for runbook adjustments. Overall earliest = 5 business days as Alex said.
tara-legal: I'll prepare SOW draft with weekly minibundle language, acceptance criteria, and a clause about customer-signed artifacts limiting Redwood's patch liability during the POC.
harry-customer: One more: Do you support HSM-backed key rotation during the POC or is that post-POC?
alex-ops: For POC we recommend static signing key for simplicity. Rotation requires coordination and retesting — we can plan it as a post-POC deliverable.
maria-sales: Action items: 1) tara to draft SOW (ETA 24h), 2) jon/alex to update runbook + manifest template (ETA 48h), 3) dina to confirm telemetry-opt-out build steps (ETA 48h), 4) maria to send quote and payment terms (ETA today).
deploy-bot: deployment pipeline: build-job triggered by jon-sol-eng at 1768456805 - status: queued.
jon-sol-eng: filing the manifest template in the repo and will ping once the build-job gets a runner.
maria-sales: Thanks team — keeping Harry cc'd. Harry, will sync procurement timeline after SOW. :thumbsup:
